quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #4
										  					
  

18 Questions • Passing Score 15

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is for vehicles with a certain number of people inside.
Only certain turns are allowed from certain lanes.
Both lanes must merge smoothly together.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is for vehicles with a certain number of people inside.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane. HOV lanes are for buses and cars with a driver plus one or more passengers, as shown on the sign.

questions.question: At a railroad crossing with no signals, you should:

options.text: Slow down and be ready to stop if you see or hear a train.
Cross the tracks as fast as you can.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop if you see or hear a train.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing with no signals, slow down and watch for trains. Be ready to stop if you see or hear a train coming.

questions.question: When driving in fog, use your:
questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights in fog. High beams bounce off the fog and back into your eyes, making it harder to see. Use fog lights if your car has them.

questions.question: When should you honk your horn?

options.text: When you are going through an intersection.
When you are passing a bicycle rider.
When you see a child about to run into the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: When you see a child about to run into the street.
questions.explanation: Use your horn as a warning when another driver or pedestrian might not see you. For example, honk if a child starts to run into the street in front of your car.

questions.question: What is the best way to reduce your risk of injury or death in a crash?

options.text: Stay in the right lane on highways.
Drive only between 3:00 p.m. and 6:00 p.m.

questions.explanation: Wearing your seat belt is the single most important thing you can do to stay safe while driving.

questions.question: If you drive slower than 40 mph on a limited-access highway, you should:

options.text: Honk your horn to warn others.

questions.explanation: If you must drive below 40 mph on a limited-access highway, use your hazard flashers to warn drivers behind you.

questions.question: Highway and expressway guide signs are what color?
questions.explanation: Highway and expressway guide signs are green with white letters.

questions.question: A steady green light means you:

options.text: Must slow down and prepare to stop.
Must stop and check for traffic before going.
May drive through if the road is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: May drive through if the road is clear.
questions.explanation: A steady green light means you may drive through the intersection if it is safe. You may also turn right or left unless a sign says you cannot. Always yield to other cars and pedestrians.

questions.question: It is illegal for anyone under 21 to ____ alcohol.
questions.explanation: It is illegal for anyone under 21 to buy or drink alcohol, carry it, or have it in a vehicle they are driving.

questions.question: Why is night driving harder than day driving?

options.text: You cannot see as well in the dark.
You see more motorcycles at night.

questions.correctAnswerText: You cannot see as well in the dark.
questions.explanation: At night, you cannot see as far ahead. Always use your headlights. Drive slowly enough to stop within the distance you can see.

questions.question: Before changing lanes on a multilane highway, you should:

options.text: Check your mirrors and blind spots.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check your mirrors and blind spots.
questions.explanation: Check your rearview and side mirrors to see if anyone is passing you. Also look over your shoulder to see if anyone is in your blind spot.

questions.question: Highway markings:

options.text: Are only found in construction zones.
Are usually red and blue in color.

questions.explanation: Highway markings give drivers important information. They help you position your vehicle correctly, show safe passing areas, and warn you about road conditions ahead.

questions.question: You notice a vehicle defect that could affect safe driving. You should:

options.text: Correct the defect as soon as possible.
Correct the defect when you can afford it.
Drive the vehicle at slower speeds.

questions.correctAnswerText: Correct the defect as soon as possible.
questions.explanation: Fix any defect that could affect safe driving right away. Do not drive the vehicle until the defect is fixed.

questions.question: The legal drinking age in this state is:
questions.explanation: The legal drinking age in Pennsylvania is 21.

questions.question: Anything that requires you to ____ could cause you to crash.

options.text: Take your eyes off the road
Take your hands off the wheel
Take your attention away from driving

questions.explanation: A distraction is anything that takes your attention away from driving, takes your eyes off the road, or takes your hands off the wheel.

questions.question: You are waiting to turn left at a multilane intersection and oncoming traffic blocks your view. You should:

options.text: Speed up quickly when the first lane is clear.
Wait until you can see all the lanes you need to cross before turning.
Wait for an oncoming driver to wave you across.
Move your car into each lane as it clears.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait until you can see all the lanes you need to cross before turning.
questions.explanation: Never start a left turn until you can see that all the lanes you need to cross are clear and it is safe to turn.

questions.question: The right edge of a road is marked by a ____ line.
questions.explanation: A solid white line marks the right edge of the road.

questions.question: Before passing another vehicle, you should:

options.text: Flash your headlights to alert the driver.
Turn on your four-way flashers to warn the driver.
Use the proper turn signal to show you are changing lanes.
Sound your horn to get the driver's attention.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use the proper turn signal to show you are changing lanes.
questions.explanation: Before passing, make sure the passing lane is clear. Use the proper turn signal early so other drivers know your plans in advance.
